        lockedUserId = nil
        lockedPlayerName = ""
        wasEverInServer = false

        av.Image = ""
        nm.Text = ""
        st.Text = "الحالة: بانتظار أدخال الهدف..."

    local foundPlr = nil
    for _, pl in ipairs(P:GetPlayers()) do

        nm.Text = lockedPlayerName

        st.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)

            st.Text = "🔴 خرج اللاعب"

local isPhysicsCustomized = false
local function resetPhysics()
    if not isPhysicsCustomized then return end
    pcall(function()
        local my = LP.Character
        if my then
            local hum = my:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then 
                hum.PlatformStand = false
                hum.Sit = false 
                hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
            end
            local hrp = my:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp then
                hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end
        end
    end)
    isPhysicsCustomized = false
end

        end
        return
    end

    pcall(function()
        if not lockedPlayer or lockedPlayer.Parent ~= P then

            return
        end

        if not lockedPlayer.Character or not lockedPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then

            return

        local myChar = LP.Character

            return 
        end
        
        local hum = myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local t = myChar.HumanoidRootPart
        local tt = lockedPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart

        isPhysicsCustomized = true
        if hum then 
            hum.PlatformStand = true

        end

        local smoothTilt = math.sin(timeTick * 30) * 0.8

        local smoothSide = math.sin(timeTick * 28) * 2.4

        if bngMagicActive then

        elseif bng1Active then

        end

    pcall(function()

        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hrp or not hum then return end

        local pos = hrp.Position
        local vel = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude

        if pos.Y > 5 and pos.Y < 300 then
            SafePoint = pos
        end

        if Toggles.AntiSit then
            hum.Sit = false
            hum.PlatformStand = false
            pcall(function()
                hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, false)
            end)
        end

        if Toggles.AntiFling and vel > 80 then
            hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end

        if Toggles.AntiTPKill then
            if lastPos and (pos - lastPos).Magnitude > 200 then
                hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(SafePoint)
            end
        end
        lastPos = pos

        if Toggles.AntiVoid and pos.Y < -25 then
            hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(SafePoint)
        end

        if Toggles.AntiGlitch and vel > 120 then
            hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
        end

        if Toggles.AntiFly then
            hum.Sit = false
            hum.PlatformStand = false
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local moveDir = hum.MoveDirection
            local targetVel = Vector3.zero
            if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then

            hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position, hrp.Position + Vector3.new(cam.LookVector.X, 0, cam.LookVector.Z))
        end
    end)

            Thickness = 1, Color = Settings.TracerColor,
            Visible = false, ZIndex = 0,
        }),
        skeleton = lines,
    }
end

local function removeObjects(player)
    local o = espObjects[player]
    if not o then return end
    pcall(function() o.box:Remove() end)
    pcall(function() o.name:Remove() end)
    pcall(function() o.tracer:Remove() end)
    for _, l in pairs(o.skeleton) do pcall(function() l:Remove() end) end
    espObjects[player] = nil
end

local function hideAll(o)
    o.box.Visible = false
    o.name.Visible = false
    o.tracer.Visible = false
    for _, l in pairs(o.skeleton) do l.Visible = false end
end

local function getClosest()
    local closest = nil
    local shortest = Settings.AimFOV
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return nil end

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character then
            if Settings.TeamCheck and player.Team and LocalPlayer.Team and player.Team == LocalPlayer.Team then
                continue
            end
            local char = player.Character
            local part = char:FindFirstChild(Settings.AimPart)
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if part and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                if onScreen and pos.Z > 0 then
                    local dist2d = (Vector2.new(mouse.X, mouse.Y) - Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y)).Magnitude
                    local dist3d = (myRoot.Position - part.Position).Magnitude
                    if dist2d < shortest and dist3d <= Settings.MaxDistance then
                        shortest = dist2d
                        closest = part
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return closest
end

local function drawSkeleton(char, lines)
    local isR15 = char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
    local offsets = isR15 and skeletonOffsets or skeletonOffsetsR6
    for i, pair in ipairs(offsets) do
        local a = char:FindFirstChild(pair[1])
        local b = char:FindFirstChild(pair[2])
        local line = lines[i]
        if a and b and line then
            local p1, on1 = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(a.Position)
            local p2, on2 = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(b.Position)
            if on1 or on2 then
                line.From = Vector2.new(p1.X, p1.Y)
                line.To = Vector2.new(p2.X, p2.Y)
                line.Color = Settings.SkeletonColor
                line.Visible = true
            else
                line.Visible = false
            end
        elseif line then
            line.Visible = false
        end
    end
    for i = #offsets + 1, #lines do
        lines[i].Visible = false
    end
end

local aiming = false

local function update()
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    fovCircle.Position = Vector2.new(mouse.X, mouse.Y + 36)
    fovCircle.Radius = Settings.AimFOV
    fovCircle.Visible = Settings.ShowFOV and Settings.AimEnabled

    if Settings.AimEnabled and aiming then
        local target = getClosest()
        if target then
            local velocity = target.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
            local predicted = target.Position + (velocity * Settings.Prediction)
            local current = Camera.CFrame
            local goal = CFrame.new(current.Position, predicted)
            Camera.CFrame = current:Lerp(goal, Settings.AimSmooth)
        end
    end

    for player, o in pairs(espObjects) do
        local char = player.Character
        local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

        if Settings.ESPEnabled and head and root and hum and hum.Health > 0 and myRoot then
            local dist = (myRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
            if dist <= Settings.MaxDistance then
                local headPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 0))
                local footPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                local rootPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)

                if onScreen then
                    if Settings.BoxESP then
                        local height = math.abs(footPos.Y - headPos.Y)
                        local width = height * 0.55
                        o.box.Position = Vector2.new(headPos.X - width/2, headPos.Y)
                        o.box.Size = Vector2.new(width, height)
                        o.box.Visible = true
                    else
                        o.box.Visible = false
                    end

                    o.name.Text = string.format("%s [%d]", player.DisplayName, math.floor(dist))
                    o.name.Position = Vector2.new(headPos.X, headPos.Y - 15)
                    o.name.Visible = true

                    if Settings.TracerESP then
                        local from
                        if Settings.TracerFrom == "Center" then
                            from = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X/2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y/2)
                        elseif Settings.TracerFrom == "Mouse" then
                            from = Vector2.new(mouse.X, mouse.Y + 36)
                        else
                            from = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X/2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y)
                        end
                        o.tracer.From = from
                        o.tracer.To = Vector2.new(rootPos.X, rootPos.Y)
                        o.tracer.Color = Settings.TracerColor
                        o.tracer.Visible = true
                    else
                        o.tracer.Visible = false
                    end

                    if Settings.SkeletonESP then
                        drawSkeleton(char, o.skeleton)
                    else
                        for _, l in pairs(o.skeleton) do l.Visible = false end
                    end
                else
                    hideAll(o)
                end
            else
                hideAll(o)
            end
        else
            hideAll(o)
        end
    end
end

-- PLAYER TELEPORTER X + ESP + THRU
-- Single LocalScript | Mobile-friendly | Movable UI

local espObjects = {}

gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.DisplayOrder = 100
gui.Parent = playerGui

local function round(obj, radius)
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
    c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
    c.Parent = obj
end

local function makeDraggable(frame, handle)
    local dragging = false
    local dragStart, startPos, activeInput

    handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = frame.Position
            activeInput = input
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and (
            input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        ) then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            frame.Position = UDim2.new(
                startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            )
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input == activeInput then
            dragging = false
            activeInput = nil
        end
    end)
end

-- MAIN WINDOW
local main = Instance.new("Frame")
main.Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 405)
main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -140, 0.5, -202)

round(header, 12)

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")

title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "Teleporter X + ESP"

thru.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 52)

thru.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

round(thru, 8)

thru.Activated:Connect(function()
    local character = player.Character

    if root then
        -- Move 5 studs forward, based on facing direction.

    end
end)

mini.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
mini.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(43, 49, 70)

    mini.Visible = true

    mini.Visible = false
    main.Visible = true

local function removeESP(target)
    local objects = espObjects[target]
    if objects then
        for _, obj in ipairs(objects) do
            if obj and obj.Parent then
                obj:Destroy()
            end
        end
        espObjects[target] = nil
    end
end

local function createESP(target)
    removeESP(target)

    if target == player or not espEnabled then return end

    local character = target.Character
    if not character then return end

    local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if not root or not head then return end

    local objects = {}
    espObjects[target] = objects

    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    highlight.Adornee = character
    highlight.FillTransparency = 1
    highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    highlight.Parent = gui
    table.insert(objects, highlight)

    local box = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
    box.Adornee = root
    box.Size = Vector3.new(4, 6, 2)
    box.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    box.Transparency = 0.25
    box.AlwaysOnTop = true
    box.ZIndex = 5
    box.Parent = gui
    table.insert(objects, box)

    local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    billboard.Adornee = head
    billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 32)
    billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
    billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
    billboard.MaxDistance = 100000
    billboard.Parent = gui
    table.insert(objects, billboard)

    local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    nameLabel.Text = target.Name
    nameLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 40)
    nameLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
    nameLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
    nameLabel.TextScaled = true
    nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    nameLabel.Parent = billboard
end

local function updateESP()
    for _, target in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if target ~= player then
            if espEnabled then
                createESP(target)
            else
                removeESP(target)
            end
        end
    end
end

espButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    espEnabled = not espEnabled
    espButton.Text = espEnabled and "ESP: ON" or "ESP: OFF"
    espButton.BackgroundColor3 = espEnabled
        and Color3.fromRGB(160, 45, 45)
        or Color3.fromRGB(65, 65, 75)
    updateESP()
end)

-- TELEPORT TO SELECTED PLAYER
local function teleportTo(target)
    if target == player then return end

    local character = player.Character
    local targetCharacter = target.Character
    if not character or not targetCharacter then return end

    local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local targetRoot = targetCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if root and targetRoot then
        root.CFrame = targetRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(3, 0, 0)
    end
end

local function refreshPlayers()
    for _, child in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("TextButton") then
            child:Destroy()
        end
    end

    for _, target in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if target ~= player then
            local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
            button.Name = "Player_" .. target.UserId
            button.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44)
            button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(58, 80, 125)
            button.Text = target.Name
            button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            button.TextSize = 15
            button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
            button.Parent = list
            round(button, 8)

            button.Activated:Connect(function()
                teleportTo(target)
            end)
        end
    end
end

local function watchPlayer(target)
    if target == player then return end

    target.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        task.wait(0.5)
        if target.Parent == Players then
            createESP(target)
        end
    end)

    if target.Character then
        createESP(target)
    end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(target)
    watchPlayer(target)
    refreshPlayers()
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(target)
    removeESP(target)
    refreshPlayers()
end)

for _, target in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    watchPlayer(target)
end

refreshPlayers()
